items.title: Keon Coleman: Team-high yardage total Sunday
items.text:
Coleman brought in four of six targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Impressive numbers in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Cousins completed 23 of 41 passes for 313 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.title: Tanner McKee: Unremarkable in Week 6 start
items.text:
McKee completed 26 of 45 passes for 215 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding one carry for no gain in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

items.title: Dameon Pierce: Logs 16 touches in lead role
items.text:
Pierce rushed 12 times for 35 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 15 yards in the Eagles' 25-14 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
